mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 48 degrees with a wind chill making it feel like 42 under overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School, all under a waning crescent moon.

The city is staying busy with pavement repairs happening November 9 and 10 on Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street. Also, the Public Works department is reminding residents to subscribe to their newsletter for important updates on street and utility work.
There is a lot going on in town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness and ART House 360 events today. Tomorrow, you can check out Hop Haus Trivia or live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard.
In a noteworthy call from October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for his first O W I offence after finding him passed out behind the wheel at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
We are looking forward to a great day with Chocolate Covered Strawberry as the flavor of the day. Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM for all your cravings.
